en: Data, facts, information, feedback; address a predetermined need; meet specific audience expectations
ms: Data, fakta, maklumat, maklum balas; penuhi keperluan ditetapkan; penuhi jangkaan audiens

ms: Analisis dan cadangan; ditulis sebagai respons kepada masalah atau peluang; pernyataan tujuan jelas

en: Essential: statement of problem or opportunity; statement of purpose and scope of investigation
Additional: tasks to accomplish, descriptions of results, project assignments, plans for following up, working outline

Tambahan: tugas, huraian hasil, tugasan projek, pelan susulan, rangka kerja

en: Plan research; prioritise information; focus on the most important question; adapt existing information
Media: observe requirements, how the audience wants to give feedback, whether searchable or editable, the message the media choice sends
ms: Rancang penyelidikan; utamakan maklumat; fokus soalan terpenting; sesuaikan maklumat sedia ada
Media: patuhi keperluan, cara audiens beri maklum balas, boleh dicari atau disunting, mesej yang dihantar pilihan media

en: Business reports, shorter messages; lead with key findings
Can work in combination with direct; more forceful report; intersperse conclusions throughout
ms: Laporan perniagaan, mesej pendek; mula dengan dapatan utama
Boleh digabung dengan terus; laporan lebih tegas; selang-seli kesimpulan sepanjang laporan

blocks.en: Slide 9 puts items in columns; the grouping above is my reading.
blocks.ms: Slaid 9 meletakkan item dalam lajur; pengelompokan di atas ialah bacaan saya.

blocks.en: The slide lists seven terms; textbook groups chronology under sequence and geography under spatial orientation.
blocks.ms: Slaid menyenaraikan tujuh istilah; buku teks mengumpulkan kronologi di bawah urutan dan geografi di bawah orientasi ruang.

blocks.en: A business plan covers **mission, structure, objectives and operations**. It is written **before the company is launched**, **when seeking funding**, or **after it is running**.
blocks.ms: Pelan perniagaan merangkumi **misi, struktur, objektif dan operasi**. Ia ditulis **sebelum syarikat dilancarkan**, **semasa mencari pembiayaan**, atau **selepas beroperasi**.

en: Problem factoring: divide into a series of questions
Ask: are you advocating one thought? Are you objectively exploring all options?
ms: Pemfaktoran masalah: bahagi kepada siri soalan
Tanya: adakah anda menyokong satu pendapat? Adakah anda meneroka semua pilihan secara objektif?

en: Direct approach, presents the main idea. Advantages: direct. Disadvantages: ignores questions, potential for oversimplification
ms: Pendekatan terus, bentang idea utama. Kelebihan: terus. Kekurangan: abaikan soalan, risiko terlalu ringkas

en: Five steps: establish need in the introduction; introduce the benefit without details; list the steps using action verbs; explain each step with procedures, costs and benefits; summarise recommendations
ms: Lima langkah: tegaskan keperluan dalam pengenalan; perkenal manfaat tanpa butiran; senarai langkah dengan kata kerja tindakan; terangkan setiap langkah dengan prosedur, kos, manfaat; ringkaskan cadangan

en: Indirect approach: the 2 + 2 = 4 approach and the yardstick approach
ms: Pendekatan tidak terus: pendekatan 2 + 2 = 4 dan pendekatan pembaris (yardstick)

blocks.en: Slide 24 says “Three Indirect Approach” but lists two (2 + 2 = 4, and yardstick). The third is not shown on the slide; check your textbook.
blocks.ms: Slaid 24 kata “Three Indirect Approach” tetapi hanya senaraikan dua (2 + 2 = 4, dan yardstick). Yang ketiga tidak ditunjukkan; semak buku teks.

en: Request decisions from within the organisation: purchase decisions or new research projects
ms: Minta keputusan dalam organisasi: keputusan pembelian atau projek penyelidikan baru

en: Request decisions from outside the organisation: grant proposals or sales proposals
ms: Minta keputusan luar organisasi: cadangan geran atau jualan

en: Expected; specific instructions; audience aware of the problem
ms: Dijangka; arahan khusus; audiens sedar masalah

en: Unexpected; more flexibility; audience unaware of the problem
ms: Tidak dijangka; lebih fleksibel; audiens tidak sedar masalah

en: Establish credibility; convince audience that the problem exists

blocks.en: Solicited = they asked, so lead with the answer. Unsolicited = they didn’t, so convince first.
blocks.ms: Solicited = mereka minta, jadi mula dengan jawapan. Unsolicited = tidak minta, jadi yakinkan dahulu.

q.en: Essential elements of a work plan?

a.en: Statement of problem or opportunity; statement of purpose and scope of investigation.
a.ms: Pernyataan masalah/peluang; pernyataan tujuan dan skop siasatan.

a.en: Tasks, descriptions of results, project assignments, follow-up plans, working outline.
a.ms: Tugas, huraian hasil, tugasan projek, pelan susulan, rangka kerja.

a.en: Lead with key findings; used for business reports and shorter messages.
a.ms: Mula dengan dapatan utama; untuk laporan perniagaan dan mesej pendek.

a.en: Monitor and control operations, implement policies and procedures, demonstrate compliance, document progress.
a.ms: Pantau dan kawal operasi, laksana dasar, tunjuk pematuhan, dokumenkan kemajuan.

a.en: Comparison, importance, sequence, spatial orientation, chronology, geography, category.
a.ms: Perbandingan, kepentingan, urutan, orientasi ruang, kronologi, geografi, kategori.

q.en: When is a business plan written?

a.en: Before launch, when seeking funding, or after the company is running.
a.ms: Sebelum pelancaran, semasa mencari pembiayaan, atau selepas beroperasi.

q.en: Seven parts of a typical business plan?

a.en: Summary, mission and objectives, company and industry, products or services, market and competition, management, marketing strategy.
a.ms: Ringkasan, misi dan objektif, syarikat dan industri, produk/perkhidmatan, pasaran dan persaingan, pengurusan, strategi pemasaran.

a.en: Assess opportunities, solve problems, support decisions.
a.ms: Menilai peluang, menyelesaikan masalah, menyokong keputusan.

a.en: What, why, who, where, how, when.
a.ms: Apa, kenapa, siapa, di mana, bagaimana, bila.

a.en: Dividing a complex problem into a series of questions.
a.ms: Membahagi masalah kompleks kepada siri soalan.

q.en: Three organisational approaches for analytical reports?

a.en: Focusing on conclusions, recommendations, logical arguments.

q.en: Five steps for a recommendation-focused report?

a.en: Establish need; introduce benefit; list steps with action verbs; explain each step; summarise.
a.ms: Tegaskan keperluan; perkenal manfaat; senarai langkah kata kerja tindakan; terangkan; ringkaskan.

q.en: Two logical-argument approaches named on the slide?
q.ms: Dua pendekatan hujah logik pada slaid?

a.en: The 2 + 2 = 4 approach and the yardstick approach.
Internal: within the organisation (purchases, research). External: outside (grant, sales).
a.ms: Dalaman: dalam organisasi (pembelian, penyelidikan). Luaran: luar (geran, jualan).

a.en: Solicited: expected, specific instructions, aware audience. Unsolicited: unexpected, flexible, unaware audience.
a.ms: Solicited: dijangka, arahan khusus, audiens sedar. Unsolicited: tidak dijangka, fleksibel, audiens tidak sedar.

a.en: Direct approach, receptive audience, focus on recommendations.
a.ms: Pendekatan terus, audiens menerima, fokus cadangan.

a.en: Indirect approach, skeptical audience, establish credibility, convince that the problem exists.
a.ms: Pendekatan tidak terus, audiens ragu, bina kredibiliti, yakinkan masalah wujud.
